summary: No security vulnerabilities, correctness bugs, or robustness issues found. Checkpoint-repo validation regex is applied consistently at all entry points (gateway, CLI, shell) before URL construction, preventing SSRF/injection. Multi-agent wave execution integrates cleanly into the pipeline runner with proper error handling (ContainerSpawnError catch flows into existing failure path). ThreadPoolExecutor+Semaphore concurrency control is correct. All new agent role enums are synchronized across contracts, orchestrator models, gateway, and dispatch mappings. The _validate_checkpoint_repo/_REPO_PATTERN helpers are duplicated in 3 files (minor DRY concern, not blocking). 14 new integration tests cover plan-phase roles, reviewer roles, write-overlap detection, and multi-agent config. All 3226 tests pass, lint clean.
